rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutional, framing an as-applied inadequacy holding under Lee v. Kemna/Ford v. Georgia without reaching Simmons merits, which fits the coalition he described. Thomas is the clear candidate to write alone in dissent, while Alito/Gorsuch/Kagan have elevated odds of short concurrences to emphasize finality limits (Alito) or the “exorbitant application”/regularity analysis (Gorsuch/Kagan).
